Candidate 1 (C384): RELATIVE DERIVED MODULI OF LOCAL SYSTEMS AND CHARACTER VARIETIES OVER SPEC Z
Claim 1: Relative derived character varieties RMap(pi_1(P^1 \ {0, 1, inf}), GL_n) over Spec Z impose non-trivial obstruction classes forbidding Beal solutions.
Method 1: Relative derived algebraic geometry, representation varieties, and schematization of homotopy types.

Candidate 2 (C385): UNIFORM BOGOMOLOV-PARSHIN ON MODULI OF CURVES OVER MIXED CHARACTERISTIC BASES
Claim 2: Uniform arithmetic Bogomolov inequality for stable curves over mixed characteristic bases provides explicit unconditional height bounds on Beal solutions.
Method 2: Arithmetic surface geometry, relative dualizing sheaves, Bogomolov-Parshin-Moriwaki inequalities, and Faltings heights.
